summary.headline: Advantia Health secures $685K in finalized annual savings with another $31K in flight
summary.narrative: Treya Partners partnered with Advantia Health to optimize spend across six priority categories, achieving $684,936 in fully-implemented, recurring annual savings in under six months.  Key wins include a 9% fee reduction with Athena for Billing/RCM, double-digit savings on Medical Supplies through distributor consolidation, and a 19% reduction in Sonography Services spend via an in-house staffing solution.  One additional category—IT Managed Services—is actively being sourced with proposals received, representing a further $31K in potential annual savings once contracts are finalized.

value_realized_in_days.source_file: Project timeline inferred from Close Out dates
value_realized_in_days.notes: First implemented savings (IUD Order Management) went live 7/11/22 roughly 1.5 months after project kickoff in late May 2022.

time_to_value.notes: Majority of finalized savings became effective between July and November 2022.

impact.operational_improvements: Established disciplined purchasing thresholds for IUDs, consolidated medical-supply distributors with formulary management, and transitioned sonography staffing to an in-house model—streamlining processes and improving cost visibility.

proof_points.statement: Fee reduction negotiated with Athena generates $259K in annual recurring savings (9%).
Competitive bid across medical-supply distributors secured 14% savings without service disruption, delivering $156K annually.
Moving from a pay-per-scan model to an in-house sonography staffing solution cuts costs by 19%, saving $152K annually.
